summary: The repaired generator passes all nine checks and all three difficulty bands against the refreshed engine binding. All 850 native grading checks passed. Unchanged source, mathematics, rendering, delivery and progression evidence was confirmed and reused.

source_analysis.skill: Recognize alternative cosine double-angle identities, expose the required pattern, and simplify to a single scaled cosine.
reasoning_steps: Identify the squared-sine or squared-cosine pattern.
Factor a common multiplier or regroup the hard polynomial.
Apply the identity once or twice, retaining the multiplier.
Simplify the angle in its original unit and select the complete expression.
invariants: Retain coefficients, signs and angle units.
Provide exactly one correct radio choice.
Show necessary conversions in the solution.
permitted_variations: Vary input form, angle, unit and common multiplier.
Vary complete plausible distractor profiles and option order.
Use justified composition of the taught identities for hard questions.

variety.details: Both input forms and angle units remain represented in every final band. Moderate includes integer, fractional and radical factors. The repair preserves sampled mathematical givens.

scope.details: Required factoring, doubling and hard regrouping steps are shown and justified. The retained negative control rejects an equivalent but unshown cofunction conversion.
